mechanism: Minocycline may increase nortriptyline levels through CYP3A4 and CYP2D6 inhibition, and both drugs increase CNS depression and anticholinergic effects; minocycline also carries photosensitivity and vestibular risk.
action: Monitor for increased tricyclic antidepressant side effects (anticholinergic symptoms, sedation, orthostasis); counsel on photosensitivity precautions and consider dose adjustment if CNS effects emerge.
